title: Finance Associate - Fixed Asset Accounting
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Support and execute monthly, quarterly and annual financial close activities ensuring accuracy and timelines. Performing fixed assets and lease accounting activities, creation of accounting schedules, Asset capitalization, journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, and variance analysis explanations. Ensure accounting and reporting comply with company accounting policies, Accounting and Finance Manual and SOX controls. Conduct detailed financial reviews and analyses to ensure integrity, accuracy and completeness of Financial Data. Assist in Internal and External Audits by preparing documentation, explanation and supporting schedules. Support Initiatives to automate and simplify accounting processes and systems. Coordinate with stakeholders across functions, demonstrating good collaboration skills. Maintain effective working relationships through regular interactions, responsiveness and customer centric mindset. 

 Preferred candidate profile 
 35 years of relevant experience in accounting operations. Handson experience with basic accounting (mandatory). Strong understanding of accounting principles Experience in fixed assets and leasing processes under US GAAP and local GAAP (advantage). Strong knowledge of SAP and S4 HANA would be added advantage. Good Knowledge of Excel and other MS office Applications. Excellent verbal communication skills in English.

Key Skills: Accruals,Asset Accounting,Lease Accounting,Journal Entries,Fixed Asset Accounting,R2R,F & A,Finance and Accounts
